agency.name: Bureau of Substance Addiction Services (BSAS), Massachusetts Department of Public Health

narrNote: MASH appears on NARR's official affiliate list; it is Massachusetts' NARR affiliate and the Department of Public Health's contracted certifying body for alcohol- and drug-free housing (NARR Level II). Since 2016, state agencies may refer clients only to MASH-certified sober homes.
notes: Agency identity from SAMHSA's SSA directory (Bureau of Substance Addiction Services, MA DPH); the BSAS page was fetched on mass.gov and publishes phone (617) 624-5111. The Behavioral Health Help Line is a service of the Commonwealth operated by the Massachusetts Behavioral Health Partnership — call or text 833-773-2445 or chat at masshelpline.com, 24/7/365; its homepage was fetched and verified. The MassHealth Covered Services page on mass.gov includes a 'Behavioral health and substance use disorder services' section. Massachusetts also operates a separate Massachusetts Substance Use Helpline (1-800-327-5050) for treatment referrals. countyDirectory is null: Massachusetts publishes no official county-level behavioral-health directory; access is organized statewide (BHHL, Mass 211) and regionally (Community Behavioral Health Centers).
